business.description: Leading manufacturer of Phosphatic Fertilizers in India, one of the largest manufacturers of Single Super Phosphate (SSP). Producer of Chemicals such as Sulphuric Acid & Oleum and engaged in extraction of Soya Oil. Markets core fertilizer products under flagship brands Girnar and Suryaphool.

outlook.statement: Fortify core operations by finalizing capacity expansions and securing raw material supply chains; accelerate innovation with new products; expand digital and advisory platforms for deeper farmer connections; evaluate strategic adjacencies and step-out investments with several advanced projects under evaluation.
Dhule SSP facility on track to be commissioned by Q2 FY 2027.
Udaipur SSP expansion by 65,000 MTPA and new GSSP, PDM, PROM plants of 49,000 MTPA aggregate capacity underway.

To become Rs 2000+ Crore turnover Company, Key focus on Chemicals & Fertilizers Segment. Strategic entry into Complex P&K, NPK and DAP Fertilizer Manufacturing. To achieve key Leadership status in SSP fertilizer on Pan-India level. To maintain trustworthy services to Indian farmers by providing one-stop Agri-solutions. To build strong brand equity and farmer loyalty across key markets. Explore more industrial chemical products to De-risk from products dependency. Expand the Fertilizers Product Portfolio by including P&K Fertilizers Imports on large scale. Profitable growth through capacity expansion and new geographies.
Improve production and reduce spillage, modification in den, chain & T-slat section
Proposal for installation of Air cooled condenser in place of water cooled condenser in Turbine
Solar panels to generate green energy
Replacement of conventional lighting with energy-efficient LED systems
Installation of VFDs and Capacitors to improve Power Factor
Auto-shut off switches for all lights for day-light power savings

Priorities for FY 2027-28: Optimise fertilizer production at all units; Secure raw materials and freight visibility early for Kharif and Rabi; Increase share of granulated and fortified SSP; Prioritize integration, inventory discipline and digital distribution readiness; Full-fledged operation of Dhule plant to increase product availability for interior penetration; Strategic Entry into Complex P&K, NPK and DAP Fertilizer Manufacturing; Achieve key Leadership status in SSP fertilizer on Pan-India level; Expand Fertilizers Product Portfolio by including P&K Fertilizers Imports on large scale; Inorganic growth strategy by acquiring SSP Unit; Explore more industrial chemical products to de-risk from products dependency; Achieve Rs. 2000 crore plus turnover

Medium Term (2029-31): Expand overall SSP capacity; Premium fertilizer market growth; Government soil health initiative; Digital agri-tech platforms; East India market entry; Favorable market dynamics due to volatility in imported fertilizer prices
Long Term (2032-35): Achieve Rs. 2000 crore plus turnover

risks: Global supply patterns for DAP highly volatile with major suppliers like China slashing exports to India
Intensive farming leaving wide stretches of Indian soil heavily deficient in secondary nutrients
Dependence on raw material supply chains
Foreign exchange fluctuations (foreign exchange loss of Rs 98 lakhs in FY26 vs gain of Rs 180 lakhs in FY25)
Geopolitical conflicts, war situations, devastating floods, global supply chain disruptions
Competition from larger PSU fertilizer companies
Commodity price risk: The Company does not undertake any commodity hedging activities as most of the raw materials are not commodities per se.
Foreign exchange risk: The Company actively monitors foreign exchange movements and takes forward covers as appropriate to reduce risks associated with transactions in foreign currencies.
